text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing, Mejiro 
Ramonu seemed to receive an incoming call 
and began speaking to someone on the 
phone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "...Oh, Baaya. So, how did it go?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fully booked...? I see.
choice_data_list: Did you have some business with me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of asking for a hair 
treatment at the salon, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...―― Things never quite go the way you 
want, do they?"

I had no choice but to head back to the 
academy. Right then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... Dear sister, and Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Good day. Are you two heading home right 
now—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —That works out just fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Which hair salon do you usually go to?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Could you check if there are any openings 
available?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm— ...Does that mean starting from 
now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: In that case, I will call them right away.

I explained the situation to Mejiro Ardan, 
who had readily responded despite the 
sudden request. And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmm... What a chic place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
So, what kind of menu do you usually ask 
for?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Besides a cut—let's see. We have this head 
spa and hair treatment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes. Then, give me that.

I was surprised by how swift the decision 
was. I thought Mejiro Ramonu was the type 
to be rather particular, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Is something on your mind? If so, why not 
just say it?
choice_data_list:
Um... I was just thinking that was a 
really quick decision.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Did something surprise you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"There is someone proving that one can 
become beautiful in this very place—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Then there's no reason to hesitate, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...! Could that be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm so happy...!
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll come along next time.
Maybe I'll come along next time, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm so happy...!
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll come along next time.
Maybe I'll come along next time, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: There! Now we smell the same!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're frolicking around like a child.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: However—yes. A gorgeous, graceful scent.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be bad to enjoy it again 
sometime.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let us certainly go together again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose that's a passing grade, for 
now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Even as a guest, one must carry oneself 
with a matching dignity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If it's an outfit like the one you have on 
today... well, it shouldn't be an issue.

It felt like they were testing me to see 
if I was worthy of being a customer... but 
it seems I've received their stamp of 
approval!
